# Tifenn Guillas

> Fullstack web developer with 8+ years of experience, specialized in Angular, TypeScript, Symfony and PHP. Based in France. Open to opportunities.

Tifenn Guillas is a French fullstack web developer. After a Biology degree, she transitioned into web development and has been building applications for over 8 years. She is specialized in Angular, TypeScript, Symfony, PHP, PostgreSQL and Docker. She values code quality, best practices, and is increasingly interested in AI-assisted development.

This site is her personal portfolio, available in French and English.

- [Portfolio FR](https://tifenn-guillas.fr/fr/): Full portfolio in French — about, skills, career, education, projects, goals, hobbies and contact.
- [Portfolio EN](https://tifenn-guillas.fr/en/): Full portfolio in English — about, skills, career, education, projects, goals, hobbies and contact.

## Sections

- About: Fullstack developer since 2016, former biology student, passionate about clean code and meaningful projects.
- Skills: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, PHP, Symfony, Doctrine, Twig, Python, Java, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Docker, Git, CI/CD, Linux, Azure.
- Career: Professional experience including work on the SVOM scientific satellite project, cybersecurity products, and various fullstack web applications.
